card.name: Linking words before 'the Constitution'
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of', 'was' or 'proposed' right before the word Constitution in US founding-era political text. It fires where the next word is expected to be Constitution.

modes.label: Article before Constitution
modes.description: The word 'the' after verbs like ratify or phrases like ratification of, just before Constitution.
modes.example: leave enough powers with the states when they were writing the Constitution. If they didn't, they knew the state legislatures would never ratify <<the>> Constitution.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words such as 'of', 'by', 'was' or 'proposed' that lead into Constitution.
modes.example: States from Invasion. The Federalist Papers were written to explain the proposed Constitution and to induce The People to ratify it. Madison is the "Father<< of>> The Constitution".

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict Constitution, constitution, founding and framers as the next word.
